sections.title: Day 35 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
- 辨識 No sooner、Only by、Not until 與假設倒裝

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜No sooner、Only by、Not until、Had/Were 條件倒裝、要求式假設語氣與主詞一致
sections.markdown:
主題：**No sooner、Only by、Not until、Had/Were 條件倒裝、要求式假設語氣與主詞一致**

### 規則 1

`No sooner + had + S + past participle + than`

> No sooner had the meeting ended than the client called.

句首 No sooner 觸發過去完成式倒裝，搭配 than。

### 規則 2

`Only by + V-ing + auxiliary + S + base verb`

> Only by comparing the quotations could we identify the surcharge.

Only by 限制片語置句首，主句倒裝；could 後接原形 identify。

### 規則 3

`Not until + clause + did + S + base verb`

> Not until the invoice arrived did Accounting release the payment.

Not until 置句首時，主要子句倒裝。

### 規則 4

`Had + S + past participle, S + would have + past participle`

> Had we noticed the discrepancy, we would have contacted the vendor.

省略 if 的過去相反假設，主句為 would have + 過去分詞。

### 規則 5

`Were + S + to + base verb, S + would + base verb`

> Were the server to fail, we would use the backup.

正式未來假設，Were ... to 與 would 搭配。

### 規則 6

`request/insist that + S + (should) + base verb`

> The director requested that the report be revised.

正式美式英文要求式假設語氣使用 be revised。

### 規則 7

`Neither A nor B / S along with X`

> Neither the manager nor the technicians are available. / The report, along with its charts, is ready.

neither ... nor 通常採鄰近一致；along with 不改變主詞單複數。

sections.title: 03 Listening｜Billing Portal — Partial Restoration
sections.markdown:
使用 transcript 進行 TTS 播放；先聽一次並提交答案，再顯示逐字稿與解析。第二輪 1.1x。

聽力稿：

> Man: Can we announce that the billing portal is fully operational again?
> Woman: Not quite. Customers can view invoices, but online payments are still disabled while the bank completes certification. The bank expects to finish by four this afternoon. A small group will test payments on Friday, and full payment access is planned for Monday.
> Man: So saying that all services are restored would be premature?
> Woman: Exactly. Please send a notice explaining what customers can use now and when payment access is expected to return.

sections.title: 04 Listening｜Temperature-Controlled Sensor Delivery
sections.markdown:
使用 transcript 進行 TTS 播放；先聽一次並提交答案，再顯示逐字稿與解析。第二輪 1.1x。

> Woman: We need forty-eight sensors delivered by Thursday at noon for the laboratory inspection. They must be transported in temperature-controlled packaging, and someone must sign for them. We cannot spend more than two hundred seventy dollars.

sections.title: 05 Listening｜Grant Portal Maintenance Extension
sections.markdown:
使用 transcript 進行 TTS 播放；先聽一次並提交答案，再顯示逐字稿與解析。第二輪 1.1x。

聽力稿：

> Attention, grant portal users. Saturday’s maintenance was originally scheduled from eight until eleven in the morning. The vendor has extended the work, and the portal is now expected to reopen at one in the afternoon. During the outage, previously downloaded application PDFs can still be read offline, but no new submissions can be made. For departments whose applications were due Saturday at five, the deadline has been extended to Monday at noon. Automatic reminders may still arrive on Saturday; they do not change the extended deadline. Any further delay will be posted on the support page at twelve thirty Saturday afternoon.

sections.title: ⑥ Reading｜Meridian Learning — Annual Licenses and Portal-Outage Exception
sections.markdown:
限時：**8 分 30 秒**。

### Meridian Learning — Annual Platform Licensing Terms

> Standard annual licenses cost $120 per purchased seat. Orders of 25 or more seats receive a 12% discount on the license subtotal only. The one-time onboarding fee is $180. Optional priority support costs $240 per order. Neither fee is discounted. Discount eligibility is based on the number of seats purchased, not the number of employees who actually use them. Seat quantities may be changed without a processing fee through November 7. Later changes normally incur a $50 processing fee.

用途：General pricing, discounts and change fees

### Westhaven Services — Purchase Order WS-408

> On November 4, Westhaven ordered 26 Standard annual licenses, onboarding, and priority support. The department's total budget is $3,100, including all fees. On November 6, two employees left the project, leaving 24 expected users. The purchasing officer is considering reducing the order to 24 or 25 seats. No change has been confirmed yet.

用途：Initial order, revised headcount and budget

### Meridian Learning — Portal Outage Exception

> Because our ordering portal was unavailable on November 7, purchase order WS-408 may confirm a revised seat quantity through November 9 without the usual $50 processing fee. Westhaven may purchase 25 licenses even though only 24 employees are expected to use the platform. The 12% discount applies to an order of 25 seats, but not 24. Onboarding and priority support remain $180 and $240, respectively. We will not adjust the order automatically. Please reply with the final seat quantity by November 9.

用途：Revised deadline and confirmation requirement

### 計算提示
- `26 seats: 26×120×0.88+180+240=3165.60`
- `24 seats: 24×120+180+240=3300.00 (no discount)`
- `25 seats: 25×120×0.88+180+240=3060.00`
- `24 vs 25 seats: 3300−3060=240.00`
- `Remaining budget for 25 seats: 3100−3060=40.00`

sections.title: ⑨ 複習與錯題分類
sections.markdown:
回顧前 **[30, 31, 32, 33, 34] 天**，完成 **[{'prompt': 'Under no circumstances _____ confidential files be shared.', 'answer': 'should', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'Hardly _____ the meeting started when the alarm sounded.', 'answer': 'had', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'Only after approval _____ the team release the report.', 'answer': 'did', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'Had it not been for the backup server, service _____ failed.', 'answer': 'would have', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'The number of complaints _____ decreased.', 'answer': 'has', 'tag': 'AGR'}, {'prompt': 'A number of vendors _____ submitted quotations.', 'answer': 'have', 'tag': 'AGR'}, {'prompt': 'The manager requested that the contract _____ revised.', 'answer': 'be', 'tag': 'G'}, {'prompt': 'I wouldn’t make that promise yet. → 這暗示什麼？', 'answer': '目前無法保證；仍有不確定性', 'tag': 'IMP'}, {'prompt': 'supersede an earlier notice = ?', 'answer': '取代先前公告', 'tag': 'U'}, {'prompt': '29 meals 不符 30 份折扣門檻，應先確認什麼？', 'answer': '折扣是否失效及總價是否反而上升', 'tag': 'BUD'}, {'prompt': 'waive a fee vs refund a fee?', 'answer': 'waive 免收；refund 退還已支付的費用', 'tag': 'V'}, {'prompt': 'in case vs provided that?', 'answer': '以防／只要（條件成立）', 'tag': 'G'}] 張**複習卡。

先遮答案、限時 90 秒回想；沒有前日作答資料時這是重點複習，而非個人實際錯題清單。

錯題標籤：

- `G`：Grammar 文法
- `V`：Vocabulary 字彙
- `L`：Listening 聽力理解
- `P`：Paraphrase 同義改寫
- `I`：Information Integration 資訊整合
- `T`：Timeline 時間順序
- `E`：Exception 特殊例外
- `U`：Updated Information 更新資訊
- `C`：Condition 條件判斷
- `N`：Next Action 下一步
- `POS`：Part of Speech 詞性
- `INT`：Intent 意圖
- `CAL`：Calculation 計算
- `SEQ`：Sequence 步驟順序
- `AGR`：Subject–Verb Agreement 主詞動詞一致
- `IMP`：Implication 隱含意圖
- `BUD`：Budget Constraint 預算限制
